Agree or disagree, with a comment
Save or replace my vote (403 if not a member)

200 Invite (the student is not a member yet)

Save INVITE (PENDING, expiresAt), outbox event JOIN_INVITE_RECEIVED
Lock the student row, then the group row
Invite ACCEPTED, add or reactivate the member row

201 Member (the student is now in the group)
Save leave request (leaderRequest = true if the Leader asks)
Outbox LEAVE_REQUESTED to the Leader, or LEADER_LEAVE_REQUESTED to the Admins
Check the roster is not locked and the window is open
Request APPROVED, member removed, outbox LEAVE_DECIDED and MEMBER_LEFT
